serverInfo.name: io.github.SPAZIO-GENESI/attest-mcp-remote
serverInfo.description: Zero-install remote MCP server for proof-of-existence file attestation.

notes: The file being attested never leaves the client: the agent computes the SHA-256 fingerprint locally and only that fingerprint is sent. Read-only tools need no credential; attesting requires a one-time human authorization (see /auth.md).
